name: – § 6 – Am 4
title: Resolution on the case of José Daniel Ferrer García in Cuba
part_text: 6. Calls on the Government of Cuba to comply with its human rights obligations under the EU-Cuba Political Dialogue and Cooperation Agreement and the international human rights treaties that Cuba has adhered to; underlines the importance of holding regular human rights dialogues between the EU and Cuba with the full participation of independent Cuban civil society organisations;
